entries.zh: 密密（紧紧挤在一起，挨得密实）
entries.en: to press close together, tightly packed; close/crowded

entries.zh: 咬紧牙齿（咬牙作响）
entries.en: to grind/clench the teeth (gnashing)

entries.zh: 催紧（把结/绳结催紧、拉紧）
entries.en: to tighten a knot; to urge/tighten
entries.notes: 漢字『催緊』[疑:緊/繫]，四欄基本互證但緊/繫二字待定

entries.zh: 寸心（内心郁结、心里憋闷）
entries.en: oppressed in heart; anguished at heart (cunxin)

entries.zh: 挾（夹住东西，挤挟至变紫/淤暗）
entries.en: to pinch/press something (till darkened)

entries.zh: 挾起来（把东西夹起来收存、攒起来）
entries.en: to pick up and set aside (by pinching), to save up

entries.zh: 執帶塊（握着一小块、捏在手里）
entries.en: to grasp and hold a piece (in the hand)
entries.notes: 漢字『執帶塊』连读略生硬，惟四栏音写一致，按把握小块释

entries.zh: 觸破（皮肤被压破、擦破皮）
entries.en: to chafe/break the skin (press until the skin breaks)

entries.zh: 抵（顶住、抵挡；相抵）
entries.en: to butt/press against; to offset/counterbalance
entries.notes: 西语词条拼写含混（apretarse conocido），汉字『抵』明确而M/R栏写法不一

entries.zh: 抵着（用手指抵着、指着）
entries.en: to press/nudge with the finger; to point with the finger

entries.zh: 算伊紧（把它箍紧，如帽箍般紧压）
entries.en: to press it tight (like a cap-band); to consider it tight
entries.notes: 漢字『算伊緊』[疑:算/轉]，且M栏 quỹn 与 R栏 zōān 对音略歧，句义靠西语 caperuza 推定

entries.notes: 四栏皆 [空]，原文此行无词条

entries.zh: 常（赶紧、勤快；劻勷/常办，与 priessa/presto/diligente 同义：急忙、勤勉）
entries.en: quick, prompt; diligent, haste (cf. Sp. priessa/presto)
entries.notes: 西语释义为 prisa/diligencia 一组，汉字『常』与 chiàp、paṅ 并置，语义衔接靠推断

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: 〔manuscript entry blank, gloss uncertain〕
entries.notes: 四栏皆 [空]，原文此行无词条

entries.zh: 气急（赶做准备、气促急忙）
entries.en: hasty preparation; breathless haste (breath quickened)
entries.notes: 西语 Preparando aquello 与汉字『氣急』语义不直接对齐，按赶工急促义折中

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: 〔source damaged: only Spanish 'Apropriasse la cabeça' legible; to take/claim the head (covering/appropriating the head)〕
entries.notes: [残]：仅西语栏可读，汉字与音写栏全空

entries.zh: 錄（考核后录取、记名录用）
entries.en: to record/enroll (one who passes examination); to approve by examination
entries.notes: 西语 aprovar examinando 与汉字『錄』配合取'考试录取'义；M栏 foan 对音与『錄』字对不上，存疑

entries.zh: 许（准许、认可）
entries.en: to permit, allow; to approve

entries.zh: 准（批准、允许）
entries.en: to approve; to permit

entries.zh: 批点（考试评定、批阅点定）
entries.en: to grade/examine (as examiner); to mark and annotate (approving the examinations)
entries.notes: 漢字『批點』[疑:批/擬]，按科考取士语境释批阅评定

entries.zh: 登科（考试及第、取得功名）
entries.en: to pass the (degree) examination; to succeed in the imperial examination

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: 〔manuscript entry blank, gloss uncertain〕
entries.notes: 四栏皆 [空]，原文此行无词条

entries.zh: 述（占别人劳作的便宜、坐享其成；白占/蹭）
entries.en: to profit from another's labor; to take advantage of another's work
entries.notes: 汉字『述』[原稿如此] 与西语义不合，M/R 音写 gui/guīn 疑对应'貱/费'类字，据西语释义折中

entries.zh: 述人咀话（占人言语便宜：学人舌、拾人话头）
entries.en: to make use of another's words; to repeat/appropriate another's talk
entries.notes: 漢字『述人咀話』[疑:咀/呾]，按西语 aprovecharse del dono habla 释占人话头

entries.zh: 功效（成效、效用；医生处方所求之效验）
entries.en: effect, efficacy (of medicine); the working result
